GRA-SS: Grassroots Ride Auction, Second-Score Restriction
An *identity* is a unique key pair.
Alice *trusts* Bob when she knows Bob personally and believes him to keep the undertakings he signs under grassroots contracts.
A person has a *location*. d > 0, an integer, and e > 0 are parameters of GDO-LB.
A *pickup delay* is measured from the award. The *terms* of a call, a parameter of GRA, state a maximum pickup delay, select a bidder, set the fare and the deposit, and say how these are released. Here: second-score terms.
*Second-score terms* state a maximum pickup delay T ≥ 0, a willingness to pay W(τ) = A − λτ with A, λ ≥ 0, and a deposit D ≥ 0. The award is at time t₀. A bid (p, τ) is the fare p ≥ 0 the bidder asks and the pickup delay τ ≥ 0 the bidder promises. Its *score* is W(τ) − p, and it is *admissible* iff τ ≤ T and its score is at least 0.
Alice, Bob and Carol are persons. A *party* to a contract is whoever has an identity, and a *person* is a party who established their own identity. Alice and Bob are persons. Alice is a rider and Bob a driver. A person can be either a rider or a driver but not both. Alice is a rider, Bob a driver and Carol a person.
GKK:1. ○ Establish: Alice may establish an identity once. Alice will make herself known by its public key, sign her acts with its private key, and be accountable for every act signed with it.
GKK:2. ■ Acquaint: Alice and Bob may jointly come to know each other.
GKK:3. ■ Introduce: Alice may introduce Carol to Bob with the consent of Bob, provided Alice and Bob know each other and Alice knows Carol.
GSG:1. ○ Befriend: Alice and Bob, who trust each other and are not friends, may jointly become friends.
GSG:2. ■ Unfriend: Alice may end her friendship with Bob.
GSG:3. ○ Loss of Trust. Alice will end her friendship with Bob if she ceases to trust him.
GDO:1, GDO-LB:1. ■ Point friend: Alice, who does not point to her friend Bob, may point to Bob, only if either Alice points to fewer than d persons and Bob is closest to Alice among all of Alice's unpointed friends, or Bob is closer to Alice by more than e than some person pointed to by Alice.
GDO:2, GDO-LB:2, GRA-SS:1. ■ Point transitive: Alice, who knows Carol and points to Bob who points to Carol, may point to Carol, only if Carol is closer to Alice by more than e than some person pointed to by Alice, and only if Carol is a driver.
GDO:3, GDO-LB:3. ■ Unpoint: Alice, who points to Bob, may cease pointing to Bob, only if Alice points to more than d persons, with Bob furthest from Alice among them.
GRA:1. ■ Call. Call: Alice, who has no open call and no ride, may call for bids on a ride from the persons Alice points to, stating the pickup point, the destination, the bidding period and the terms. Forward call: Each of them forwards the call to the persons they point to.
GRA:2. ■ Bid: Bob, who received the call, may bid a fare and a pickup delay before the bidding period ends; Alice may not open a bid before then.
GRA:3, GRA-SS:2. ■ Award. Award: After the bidding period ends, Alice may award the ride to the bidder the terms select among the bidders who have no ride, at the fare the terms set; Alice's fare and the deposit the terms set for Bob are then locked, where the terms select the bidder whose admissible bid has the highest score, ties broken as the terms say, or no bidder if no bid is admissible. Close: If the terms select no bidder, Alice may close the call, where the terms select the bidder whose admissible bid has the highest score, ties broken as the terms say, or no bidder if no bid is admissible. They set the fare P = W(τ) − s₂, where τ is that bid's pickup delay and s₂ is the highest score among the other admissible bids, or 0 if there is none, and they set the deposit D.
GRA:4. ■ Pickup: The pickup is recorded when Alice and Bob are both at the pickup point.
GRA:5, GRA-SS:3. ■ Arrive: When Alice and Bob are both at the destination, the fare and the deposit are released to Alice and to Bob as the terms say, where the refund min{P, λδ} is released to Alice, and the rest of the fare and the deposit to Bob, with δ = max{0, t_pickup − t₀ − τ}.
GRA:6, GRA-SS:4. ■ Cancel: If no pickup is recorded within the maximum pickup delay, Alice may cancel; the fare and the deposit are then released to Alice and to Bob as the terms say, where the fare and the deposit are released to Alice if Alice was at the pickup point from t₀ to t₀ + T, and otherwise the fare to Alice and the deposit to Bob.
GRA:7. ■ Withdraw: Alice may withdraw her open call before the bidding period ends.
